newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds edge lower but demand at short end.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds edge lower but demand at short end.

text.p: 1600 GMT - Austrian bonds ended lower after a session characterised by uneventful range trading. Market participants reported a muted response to sacking of Russian security chief Lebed.
Demand centred on bonds with short and medium maturities.
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent down 25 bps at 101.25 to yield 6.08 (6.05) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.18/28 to yield 6.09/08 percent.

* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 unchanged down 10 bps at 102.35 to yield 4.92 (4.90) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 102.24/34 to yield 4.95/92 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds up one bp at six bps, five-year spread down two bps at minus two.
* December AGB future down seven bps at 105.46 on volume of 135 contracts.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.318 and overnight money at 1.00-08.
